setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern, C3 D3 E3 F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, through the test MIDI device at 90 BPM with Rate /1 and channel range steps 1-4. The sequencer is stopped. Every Mosaic option is at its default, so Wrap param slides is Off, and nothing is locked yet.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Open Channel tasks > Trig params and assign the device's CC 1 to a trig slot. The channel default for CC 1 is 63.
steps.title: Assign CC 1 to a trig slot

steps.caption: Press K3 to confirm the CC 1 assignment and K2 to go back. Hold step 1 and turn E3 to 24. Slot 1 shows 24 with an L in its corner while the step is held. Release the step.
steps.title: Lock step 1 to 24

steps.caption: Hold step 3 and turn E3 to 96. Slot 1 shows 96 with the L. Release the step.
steps.title: Lock step 3 to 96

steps.caption: Hold step 4 and turn E3 to 48. Slot 1 shows 48 with the L. Step 2 gets no lock and keeps the channel default, 63.
steps.title: Lock step 4 to 48

steps.caption: Hold step 1 and press K3. Slot 1 shows 24 with an S in its corner, so the lock on step 1 now slides toward the next lock. Release the step.
steps.title: Turn a step slide on

steps.caption: Hold step 1 and press K3 again. The S goes and the L returns, so step 1 jumps again. Release the step.
steps.title: Turn the step slide off again

steps.caption: Play two loops. With no slide, CC 1 does not glide from 24 to 96. Each loop the MIDI strip shows only 24 on step 1, 63 on step 2 (the channel default, because step 2 has no lock), 96 on step 3 and 48 on step 4.
steps.title: Play without a slide

steps.caption: Hold step 4 and press K3 to give the last lock (48) a slide. Slot 1 shows 48 with the S.
steps.title: Slide the last lock

steps.caption: Wrap param slides is still Off, so there is no later lock to slide toward: CC 1 stays at 48 through step 4, and the first lock, 24, is recalled when the loop restarts. Play and listen for the value changing abruptly at the loop point.
steps.title: Give the last lock no destination

steps.caption: Tap K1, open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Wrap param slides and turn E3 right to On. The row reads On.
steps.title: Turn Wrap param slides on

steps.caption: Tap K1 to return to Mosaic and play. The step-4 slide now runs from 48 down to 24 across one sixteenth-note step (one sixth of a second): CC 1 passes 40 and 32 and reaches 24 exactly with the first note of the next loop. Look for those CC values in the MIDI strip. Use this for a cyclic sweep, such as a filter that falls back to its start with no jump at the loop point.
steps.title: Slide to the first lock

title: Carry a slide across the loop boundary
